rules.statement: A donor can revoke a gift of property on the birth of a legitimate child if it is not clear that the donor intended to renounce this right.
rules.supporting_quote: "The words used in the present deed are: 'On the occasion . . .. .. .to the said donee as gift absolute and irrevocable . . . . absolutely for ever, &c. ' The learned District Judge has not considered that these words make it quite plain that the donor intended to renounce his undoubted right of revocation after the subsequent birth of children."
